They are commonly wielded by Gerudo women, especially travelers that journey through the [[Gerudo Desert]]. They belong to the [[Gerudo Gear]] equipment archetype. People who carry Gerudo Scimitars are often seen carrying [[Gerudo Shield]]s as well. They are common in the [[Gerudo Desert]], particularly around [[Gerudo Town]] and the [[Kara Kara Bazaar]], as well as in the [[Gerudo Highlands]]. Gerudo Scimitars can be found inside Gerudo Town. They may also be wielded by [[Enemy|Enemies]] throughout the Gerudo Desert, such as [[Electric Lizalfos]]. The {{BotW}} Series [[Urbosa]] [[amiibo]] also has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Gerudo Scimitar when it is scanned by the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. A Gerudo Scimitar is required to remake the [[Scimitar of the Seven]], along with five pieces of [[Flint]] and a [[Diamond]]. Due to being made of metal, Gerudo Scimitars will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]], and they can also conduct [[Electricity]]. They will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] Rune.
